activateConfig(bytes32).details: This function can be called by the contract admin to activate a configuration.

deactivateConfig(bytes32).details: This function can be called by the contract admin to deactivate an incorrect configuration.

params.configDigest: Config Digest to fetch data for

returns.blockNumber: block at which this config was set

params.configDigest: The digest of the configuration we're setting
params.f: number of faulty oracles the system can tolerate
params.recipientAddressesAndWeights: the addresses and weights of all the recipients to receive rewards
params.signers: addresses with which oracles sign the reports

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. params.configDigest: The digest of the configuration we're updating

params.sender: The address that requested to verify the contract. This is only used for logging purposes.
params.signedReport: The encoded data to be verified.
